verdict.rationale: Kit's create-broadcast API can save a broadcast as a draft or schedule it, and can target segment or tag IDs. The official Kit MCP exposes broadcasts and segments to AI clients, with the documented example prompt "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week". So an agent can create a segment-targeted draft that a human later reviews and sends. Missing for 10: an explicit approval/review gate or workflow (human sign-off is only implied by the draft state), documentation of the MCP's specific broadcast tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
